name: Fuertescusa (Spain)
description: Green field charged with a blue triangle from the hoist corners to the middle of the fly, itself charged with a white triangle from the hoist corners to the centre bearing the crowned municipal arms of Fuertescusa (an arch with a mount and a pine on yellow).
history: The council of Fuertescusa resolved to adopt the arms and the local flag, described as a rectangular flag of 2:3 formed of a green cloth charged with a blue triangle whose vertices are at the ends of the hoist and the midpoint of the fly, itself charged with a white triangle whose vertices are at the ends of the hoist and the centre of the flag.
